static_profile_domain.preimage: The canonical descriptor installed-profile.json of Plans/workflow_combined_source_contracts/, serialized as sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON with no prefix and no trailing LF (CV-352). Its complete member list binds every placed whole active schema, map, protocol, physical, phase and binding companion and every canonical dependency by Plans/ path, SHA-256 and bytes.
static_profile_domain.digest: SHA-256 of the sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of installed-profile.json, no prefix, no trailing LF (SHA256_SORTED_KEY_COMPACT_UTF8_NO_PREFIX_NO_LF)
exclusions: runtime native values, original operation IDs or original issuance results
static_profile_domain.native_binding: Original WorkflowBirth.installed_contract_digest and combined Enrollment.installed_descriptor_sha256 equal this actual installed static digest. It is never a proof that registration or installation happened.
static_profile_domain.descriptor_transport: StorageAcquisitionSource.installed_descriptor_bytes_base64 transports exactly this sorted-key compact serialization, so the transported exact bytes and the CV-352 digest preimage are the same bytes.

complete_boundary_domain.name: pm.workflow.combined_boundary_input.v1
complete_boundary_domain.codec: Complete existing pm.workflow.activation_source_json.v1 encoding; native original nested values retain their own exact original byte/hash domains. No bespoke numeric/escaping rule.
preimage_fields: ordered complete actual argument tuple from all exact method and phase declarations
complete actual combined guard argument, including its whole original StorageAcquisitionSource or raw acquisition input for the base case
complete_boundary_domain.argument_identity: Each tuple entry carries actual fixed position/name/realm/schema ref and the complete typed value, selected by real registration. JSON supplied declarations or branch tags cannot choose its schema.
forbidden: hash of a selected field subset in place of any full required value
using current guard metadata as a reconstruction of an old original full source
substituting the combined digest for any original source/Goal/producer/candidate/output commitment
complete_boundary_domain.uses: SlotOrigin.input_sha256 commits this complete invocation where that real original operation changes the slot. All ordinary native publications continue their full original commitment fields/domains and independently mandatory combined entry/final guards; no new untyped durable native body field or retrospective source archive is introduced.

slot_domains.enrollment: Derive from genuine original birth/origin and static descriptor; then hash complete physical Enrollment.
slot_domains.slot: Derive complete next Slot and immutable SlotRevision from original before journal/source and exact original phase/control candidate. claim_origin_key is a key only, with no future origin hash.
slot_domains.slot_origin: After both physical slot values are fixed, derive SlotOrigin with both exact physical selections, complete input digest and original issuer/transaction. No Slot value embeds this future SlotOrigin hash.
slot_domains.recovery: Authentic original origin proves its own original issuance only. Replaying a different current snapshot does not recreate its full input; missing original full sources remain unavailable for full-source claims.

original_native_and_producer: Retain exact original source/candidate/native output/origin, producer semantic/full, original full Event/receipt/custody, append link/completion/origin, observer and source-token domains. New source roots define complete new typed inputs; no hash cuts or prefix-only comparisons. The pure clock-split payload remains exact original v3.
